lines.text: Many learners say: What hour is it?
For the clock, say what time.

data.why: For the clock, say what time.

native.tip: En español “¿qué hora es?”, pero en inglés se pregunta “what time”, no “what hour.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “What hour is it?” Para preguntar la hora, usa “time”, no “hour”: “What time is it?” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “time”. Para saber la hora di “What time is it?”; “hour” es un periodo de 60 minutos. Escribe una frase tuya con “time” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “qué hora”, but English asks “what time is it?”
en.caption: Common mistake: “What hour is it?” To ask about the clock, use “time”, not “hour”: “What time is it?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
